# requires: wire
#
# `bytes=40-` asked for the tail and the answer was `bytes 40-47/64`: eight
# bytes, correctly labelled, and the connection closed. A CDN serving fixed
# chunks does this on every request. The transfer is not finished and nothing in
# the response is wrong, so an implementation that reads the end of a body as
# the end of an artifact delivers a truncated file under the final name.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:subspan
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
orphans
state A

# expect 6: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 6: done=48 err=set [DL-R14]
# expect 7: ok A
